roles.name: Physician
roles.description: Diagnoses and treats complex illnesses, interprets AI diagnostics, prescribes medications, and directs patient care plans.
responsibilities: Diagnose acute and chronic illnesses through comprehensive clinical exams and diagnostics
Prescribe evidence-based therapeutic regimens and monitor patient physiological responses
Direct multidisciplinary patient care teams and formulate comprehensive care plans
Educate patients and families on preventative healthcare, lifestyle adjustments, and wellness
roles.careerPath: Resident Physician -> Attending Physician -> Department Chair -> Chief Medical Officer (CMO)

roles.name: Nurse Practitioner
roles.description: Advanced practice registered nurse delivering autonomous clinical care, prescribing medications, and managing health outcomes.
responsibilities: Provide advanced clinical care, order diagnostic labs, and interpret radiographic findings
Manage primary and specialty healthcare conditions with independent practice authority
Prescribe medications, medical devices, and rehabilitation therapies
Coordinate complex patient referrals and preventative screening initiatives
roles.careerPath: Staff Nurse -> Nurse Practitioner -> Lead Clinical NP -> Director of Advanced Practice Nursing

roles.name: Staff Nurse
roles.description: Administers acute bedside care, IV medications, real-time vital telemetry, and patient stabilization.
responsibilities: Administer IV medications, monitor continuous telemetry vitals, and assess patient status
Document electronic health records (EHR) adhering strictly to safety standards
Perform wound dressing changes, post-operative care, and emergency resuscitation
Advocate for patient comfort, informed consent, and holistic bedside well-being
roles.careerPath: Graduate Nurse -> Staff Nurse -> Charge Nurse -> Nurse Manager -> Director of Nursing

roles.name: Surgeon
roles.description: Performs robotic-assisted and minimally invasive operative procedures to treat complex conditions and trauma.
responsibilities: Perform complex operative interventions using open, laparoscopic, and robotic techniques
Assess preoperative surgical indications, risks, and perioperative management plans
Lead surgical scrub teams, surgical residents, and operating room nursing staff
Manage post-operative recovery, surgical wound healing, and complication mitigation
certifications: Fellow of the American College of Surgeons (FACS)
roles.careerPath: Surgical Resident -> Fellow -> Attending Surgeon -> Chief of Surgery

roles.name: Neurosurgeon
roles.description: Performs high-precision microsurgery and stereotactic radiosurgery on the brain, spine, and central nervous system.
responsibilities: Execute microsurgical procedures on the brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nervous system
Treat intracranial aneurysms, glioblastomas, spinal deformities, and traumatic brain injuries
Utilize intraoperative stereotactic navigation, neural monitoring, and robotic spine guidance
Oversee intensive neurocritical care management and intracranial pressure stabilization
certifications: American Board of Neurological Surgery (ABNS) Certified
roles.careerPath: Neurosurgery Resident -> Fellow -> Attending Neurosurgeon -> Chair of Neurosurgery

roles.name: Cardiologist
roles.description: Specializes in cardiovascular disease management, interventional catheterization, echocardiography, and cardiac electrophysiology.
responsibilities: Diagnose cardiovascular disease through echocardiograms, ECG stress tests, and cardiac MRI
Manage heart failure, coronary artery disease, hypertension, and complex arrhythmias
Collaborate with interventional cardiologists for catheterization and stent placement
Direct cardiac rehabilitation and preventative lipid management programs
certifications: American Board of Internal Medicine: Cardiovascular Disease
roles.careerPath: Fellow -> Clinical Cardiologist -> Chief of Cardiology -> Heart Institute Director

roles.name: Anesthesiologist
roles.description: Administers precision anesthesia, targeted nerve blocks, and manages hemodynamic stability and pain during surgery.
responsibilities: Formulate anesthesia plans (general, regional, spinal, monitored sedation) tailored to surgery
Manage hemodynamic stability, mechanical ventilation, and arterial line monitoring intraoperatively
Oversee post-anesthesia care unit (PACU) recovery and acute surgical pain control
Lead acute airway management and cardiac arrest response teams
roles.careerPath: Resident -> Attending Anesthesiologist -> Director of Anesthesia Services

roles.name: Pharmacist
roles.description: Oversees precision pharmacotherapy, clinical drug interactions, automated dispensing, and patient medication therapy management.
responsibilities: Verify medication orders for contraindications, dosage accuracy, and adverse drug interactions
Compound sterile IV infusions, chemotherapy admixtures, and specialized formulations
Provide pharmacotherapy consultations to physicians regarding antimicrobial stewardship
Educate patients on prescription usage, potential side effects, and adherence regimens
roles.careerPath: Clinical Pharmacist -> Lead Hospital Pharmacist -> Director of Pharmacy Services

roles.name: Medical Laboratory Scientist
roles.description: Executes complex clinical diagnostic assays, molecular PCR diagnostics, hematology analysis, and immunoassays.
responsibilities: Perform complex chemical, hematological, immunological, and microbiological laboratory assays
Calibrate automated clinical analyzers and maintain strict quality control (QC) logs
Identify cellular abnormalities in peripheral blood smears and body fluids
Crossmatch blood products for life-saving transfusion compatibility
roles.careerPath: Lab Tech -> Medical Laboratory Scientist -> Lab Supervisor -> Clinical Laboratory Director

roles.name: Radiologic Technologist
roles.description: Performs diagnostic imaging using CT scanners, high-field MRI, digital radiography, and AI triage systems.
responsibilities: Operate diagnostic imaging equipment: X-ray, computed tomography (CT), and MRI scanners
Position patients accurately to capture diagnostic radiographic projections while minimizing radiation dose (ALARA)
Administer radiopaque contrast media and monitor patients for adverse allergic reactions
Archive high-resolution DICOM images to hospital PACS systems
certifications: ARRT (American Registry of Radiologic Technologists) Certified (RT(R))
roles.careerPath: Radiologic Tech -> Senior CT/MRI Technologist -> Radiology Operations Manager

roles.name: Physician Assistant
roles.description: Performs comprehensive medical examinations, formulates treatment plans, assists in surgery, and prescribes medications.
responsibilities: Conduct comprehensive physical exams, order diagnostic testing, and synthesize diagnoses
First-assist in surgical operations and perform bedside procedures (suturing, line placements)
Formulate treatment plans and prescribe medications under physician collaboration
Round on hospitalized inpatients and manage routine outpatient clinic schedules
roles.careerPath: Physician Assistant -> Lead Clinical PA -> Director of Allied Health

roles.name: Pediatrician
roles.description: Provides dedicated medical care, neurodevelopmental screening, immunizations, and wellness tracking for infants and adolescents.
responsibilities: Monitor childhood growth milestones, cognitive development, and nutritional guidelines
Administer pediatric immunization schedules and treat acute childhood infections
Screen for behavioral, developmental, and emotional conditions (ADHD, autism spectrum)
Counsel parents on child safety, sleep routines, and developmental psychology
roles.careerPath: Pediatric Resident -> Attending Pediatrician -> Chief of Pediatrics

roles.name: Physical Therapist
roles.description: Designs biomechanical rehabilitation protocols, neuromuscular re-education, and robotic gait therapy.
responsibilities: Evaluate musculoskeletal, neurological, and post-surgical movement dysfunctions
Develop personalized rehabilitation plans with therapeutic exercise and manual joint mobilizations
Utilize gait analysis, neuromuscular reeducation, and modalities (ultrasound, electrical stimulation)
Educate patients on ergonomic modifications and home exercise programs to prevent reinjury
roles.careerPath: Physical Therapist -> Clinical Specialist -> Rehabilitation Clinic Director

roles.name: Occupational Therapist
roles.description: Assists patients in restoring functional independence, fine motor skills, cognitive function, and adaptive technology usage.
responsibilities: Assess patients' functional capacity to perform essential activities of daily living (ADLs)
Design adaptive strategies and prescribe assistive technology equipment for independence
Perform upper extremity rehabilitation, fine motor retraining, and cognitive exercises
Conduct home safety evaluations for wheelchair accessibility and fall prevention
roles.careerPath: Occupational Therapist -> Senior Clinical Specialist -> Director of Therapy Services

roles.name: Medical Assistant
roles.description: Facilitates outpatient intake, vital sign logging, phlebotomy, schedule management, and electronic chart preparation.
responsibilities: Obtain patient vital signs (blood pressure, temperature, pulse oximetry) and record medical histories
Prepare exam rooms, sterilize clinical instruments, and assist physicians during minor procedures
Administer routine intramuscular injections, perform phlebotomy, and collect lab specimens
Manage appointment scheduling, prescription refill requests, and patient triage calls
roles.careerPath: Medical Assistant -> Lead Clinical MA -> Medical Office Coordinator -> Clinic Manager

roles.name: Health Informatics Specialist
roles.description: Optimizes clinical electronic health records (EHR), medical data taxonomy, interoperability standards, and health system workflows.
responsibilities: Implement FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) and HL7 messaging pipelines
Optimize Epic/Cerner clinical decision support (CDS) alerts and clinical documentation templates
Audit clinical coding taxonomies (ICD-10, SNOMED-CT, LOINC, CPT) for compliance
Analyze patient readmission metrics and clinical workflow friction
roles.careerPath: Clinical Analyst -> Health Informatics Specialist -> Chief Medical Information Officer (CMIO)

roles.name: Clinical Research Coordinator
roles.description: Oversees FDA-regulated clinical trials, patient recruitment, protocol adherence, and clinical study data integrity.
responsibilities: Screen and enroll eligible clinical trial participants following strict inclusion criteria
Coordinate informed consent documentation and institutional review board (IRB) filings
Administer investigational medicinal products (IMP) under strict GCP protocols
Report Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) and maintain electronic case report forms (eCRF)
roles.careerPath: Research Assistant -> Clinical Research Coordinator -> Clinical Project Manager -> Director of Clinical Operations

roles.name: Biomedical Engineer
roles.description: Designs life-saving medical devices, robotic surgery systems, diagnostic biosensors, and artificial organ prosthetics.
responsibilities: Design physiological monitors, infusion pumps, and wearable biosensor electronics
Validate FDA 510(k) and PMA medical device regulatory submissions and ISO 13485 standards
Conduct biocompatibility testing (ISO 10993) and risk management audits (ISO 14971)
Simulate biomechanical stresses and fluid dynamics in cardiovascular implants
roles.careerPath: Biomedical Engineer -> Senior Medical Device Architect -> VP of Medical Technology

roles.name: Telemedicine Clinical Specialist
roles.description: Coordinates virtual patient triage, remote patient monitoring (RPM) telemetry, and digital health consultations.
responsibilities: Deliver video consultations and triage patient acuity for remote digital care
Monitor continuous cellular RPM data (continuous glucose monitors, blood pressure cuffs, pulse oximetry)
Optimize telehealth clinical protocols and multi-state medical licensing compliance
Educate elderly and rural patients on using digital health portals and connected health devices
roles.careerPath: Telehealth Coordinator -> Telemedicine Specialist -> Director of Virtual Care

roles.name: Genomic Data Analyst
roles.description: Analyzes high-throughput Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) data to identify genetic variants and disease predispositions.
responsibilities: Execute whole-genome (WGS) and exome (WES) sequencing bioinformatics pipelines (GATK, BWA)
Annotate single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) and structural variants using ClinVar and gnomAD
Interpret variant pathogenicity according to ACMG/AMP clinical guidelines
Author comprehensive clinical genomic diagnostic reports for medical oncologists and geneticists
roles.careerPath: Bioinformatician -> Genomic Data Analyst -> Lead Variant Scientist -> Director of Precision Medicine

roles.name: Healthcare AI & Regulatory Specialist
roles.description: Validates clinical artificial intelligence models for safety, algorithmic bias, FDA Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) clearance.
responsibilities: Prepare FDA SaMD premarket notification 510(k) and De Novo regulatory documentation for clinical AI
Evaluate deep learning radiology and pathology algorithms against multi-hospital benchmark cohorts
Audit clinical models for demographic bias, calibration drift, and hallucination risks
Collaborate with hospital clinical governance committees on clinical AI deployment ethics
roles.careerPath: Regulatory Affairs Specialist -> Healthcare AI Specialist -> Chief Regulatory Officer

roles.name: Hospital Administrator
roles.description: Directs hospital operational finances, regulatory accreditation (Joint Commission), bed capacity, and clinical staffing.
responsibilities: Manage multi-departmental hospital operating budgets, revenue cycle management, and capital projects
Oversee emergency preparedness, bed throughput, and surgical theater scheduling efficiency
Maintain accreditation readiness for The Joint Commission (TJC) and CMS inspections
Lead physician retention, nursing union negotiations, and patient satisfaction (HCAHPS) programs
certifications: FACHE (Fellow of the American College of Healthcare Executives)
roles.careerPath: Operations Manager -> Associate Administrator -> Hospital COO -> Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

roles.name: Biostatistician & Epidemiologist
roles.description: Designs epidemiological surveillance models, infectious disease tracking, and statistical analyses for public health.
responsibilities: Model epidemic transmission curves (SEIR models), outbreak clusters, and vaccine efficacy
Formulate multivariate regression models and survival analyses (Kaplan-Meier, Cox Proportional Hazards)
Analyze population health survey registries (NHANES, CDC BRFSS) to guide healthcare policy
Publish epidemiological bulletins and advise public health commissioners
roles.careerPath: Epidemiologist -> Senior Biostatistician -> Chief Epidemiologist -> Director of Public Health

roles.name: Emergency Medicine Physician
roles.description: Stabilizes acute traumatic injuries, cardiac arrests, acute respiratory failure, and urgent medical emergencies.
responsibilities: Rapidly triage and resuscitate critically ill medical and trauma resuscitation patients
Perform emergency procedures: endotracheal intubation, chest tube thoracostomy, central venous access
Interpret emergency point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS), head CTs, and acute ECGs
Coordinate trauma activations, mass casualty incident protocols, and ICU admissions
roles.careerPath: Emergency Medicine Resident -> Attending ER Physician -> Medical Director of Emergency Services

roles.name: Clinical Geneticist
roles.description: Diagnoses hereditary syndromes, metabolic disorders, and congenital abnormalities, guiding targeted genomic counseling.
responsibilities: Evaluate pediatric and adult patients for rare inherited genetic conditions and dysmorphology
Order and interpret chromosomal microarrays, karyotypes, and exome sequencing panels
Provide empathetic genetic counseling on inheritance risks, recurrence chances, and prenatal options
Coordinate enzyme replacement therapies and precision clinical trials for metabolic diseases
certifications: American Board of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ABMGG) Certified
roles.careerPath: Genetics Fellow -> Clinical Geneticist -> Director of Medical Genetics
